description: This Java source file defines the 'CommonWidgetModels' class, which contains shared widget model classes such as Link, Image, Parameter, and auto-parameter classes, used for rendering and handling widgets in the OFBiz framework. It provides utility methods for parameter extraction, callback propagation, and widget component modelling including links, images, and parameters.

classes.name: AutoEntityParameters
classes.description: Handles auto-generation of entity parameters based on XML configuration, including entity name, exclude list, inclusion flags, and parameter retrieval logic based on context and model entity fields.

classes.name: AutoServiceParameters
classes.description: Handles automatic inclusion of service parameters based on XML configuration, including service name, exclude list, and parameter extraction from context.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image widget with attributes like source, alternate text, title, style, dimensions, URL mode, and methods to expand these attributes based on the current context.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink widget, including properties for URL, text, ID, target, style, confirmation message, associated images, parameters, and callback handling. Supports various configurations from XML elements or programmatic creation.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Represents a widget parameter with optional dynamic value expander, source field, and support for event result referencing.

classes.name: ParameterFactory
classes.description: Utility class for creating Parameter instances from map entries, converting values appropriately.

methods.name: getParametersMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of parameters based on the context, default entity or service name, and associated configurations, with support for propagating callbacks.

methods.name: propagateCallbackInParameterMap
methods.description: Adds callback information to the parameter map if applicable, handling JWT tokens and callback objects.
